task.title: To create a Data Set action
task.shortdesc: Before you create a Data Set action step for an Action flow, make sure that

step.cmd: Click on the arrow beneath the Actions button and select Data Set.
Enter an Action Name. Use a descriptive name. For example, Data Set Product Name.
From the Object drop-down list, select an Object. The object of the Data Set must be the same as those of the split Query Actions.
Specify the operator for the Data Set as AND or OR. The output of the different queries is merged into the Data Set, either as a union or an intersection.

Navigate to Action Flows, do any of the following:To create a new Action flow, click Create, and enter a name for the action flow. Click Add a step.To add a Data Set to an existing Action Flow, select the existing Action Flow and click Edit. Click Add a Step.

substep.cmd: To create a new Action flow, click Create, and enter a name for the action flow. Click Add a step.
To add a Data Set to an existing Action Flow, select the existing Action Flow and click Edit. Click Add a Step.

note.p: Before you create a Data Set action step for an Action flow, make sure that steps for the Query Actions exist.

step.cmd: Select the Data Set Action. The Data Set Action that you specify must have subsequent Query Action flows created for it based on the object you select.
Specify the name of the Data Set Action Output.
Make sure to select the Provide Input and Persist Data in Output check boxes.
In the Action Input Area, specify the query actions from which the output is merged.
